prompt: Compose an original 90-second instrumental game background cue for energetic tactical combat, menu state. Instruments: low strings, brass, tight cinematic drums. 140 BPM, exact steady 4/4. Energy 2/5. Use a repeating eight-bar harmonic cycle. Variation: gentle suspended chords and sparse upper notes. Stable consistent texture from the first bar through the last bar, no intro, no build, no breaks, no final cadence or fade. No tempo changes. Keep the lead sparse so repeated playback is comfortable. Original composition for a reusable game loop. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. No imitation of any artist, song, film, game or brand.

description.en: An energetic electronic track featuring a driving beat, prominent synth bass, and melodic synth lines. It has a consistent rhythm and builds slightly in intensity.
description.zh: 一首充满活力的电子音乐，具有强劲的节拍、突出的合成器低音和旋律优美的合成器线条。它节奏稳定，强度略有增强。
